description: This Java source file defines the class NottableSchemaString, which extends NottableString. It handles JSON schema validation, parsing schema strings, and matching JSON data against schemas within the MockServer project.

classes.name: NottableSchemaString
classes.description: A class representing a schema string with validation and matching capabilities, supporting JSON schema validation within the MockServer framework.

methods.name: schemaString
methods.description: Static factory method to create a NottableSchemaString with a value and not flag.

methods.name: notSchema
methods.description: Static factory method to create a NottableSchemaString marked as a negation schema.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Checks if a given JSON string matches the schema, with optional logging and difference tracking.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a JSON string against the schema, returning validation errors if any.

methods.name: getSchemaJsonNode
methods.description: Parses a schema string into a JSON node, removing embedded 'not' fields.

methods.name: convertToJsonNode
methods.description: Converts a string value to a JSON node based on its type and format.

methods.name: getNodeValue
methods.description: Retrieves the text value of a specified field from a JSON node.
